run_low_shot_sampling: run the script to generate low-shot VOC samples for SVM training with specified k-values
create_low_shot_samples: create independent low-shot challenge samples from VOC image labels across multiple k-values
load_json_targets: load a JSON file of image labels into a numpy array with sorted image IDs and class names
sample_symbol: sample a specified number of positive or negative labels per class from target arrays
save_json_labels: save a numpy array of sampled labels back to a JSON file with image IDs and class names
